clearedSpotChecks.check: Opcode battery (99,985 vectors) and targeted set (85,544 vectors) at the builds the endpoints report at 17:12 UTC on 2026-11-27, covering ADDMOD and MULMOD at the ruint 1.21.0 fault condition, the 512 bit mulDiv product, DIV, MOD, SDIV, SMOD, SIGNEXTEND, BYTE, shifts and EXP.
clearedSpotChecks.note: The verifier ran its own 26 edge vectors by eth_call with a code override on all seven endpoints on 2026-11-27. They included MULMOD with modulus 2^256 - 1 on two-limb-heavy operands, MULMOD with a modulus built from the high half of the product, ADDMOD at overflow, SDIV and SMOD of the minimum value by -1, SAR, SHL and SHR with shift words above 255 and above 2^64, BYTE and SIGNEXTEND with indices above 31 and above 2^64, EXP, and DIV and MOD by multi-limb divisors. All 182 answers equal Python big integer results. The endpoints reported op-reth/v2.8.1-72207294 (OP Mainnet), reth/v2.5.2 base/v1.5.6 (Base), op-reth/v2.10.0-rc.4-65e80332 (Unichain, Ink, Soneium), conduit-op-reth/v2.5.1-8f0ccac (Zora) and world-chain/v2.8.2-9596311 (World Chain), the builds the research file names. The same mulmod(a, b, not(0)) and mulmod(a, b, denominator) words feed prod1 and the remainder at src/libraries/FullMath.sol:24-25 and 48, and the rounding check at src/libraries/FullMath.sol:112, so those lines see Ethereum results on these builds.

clearedSpotChecks.note: The verifier did not rerun the binary model. The build strings it read from both endpoints (world-chain/v2.8.2-9596311 and conduit-op-reth/v2.5.1-8f0ccac) match the revision 95963111 and the 8f0ccac string the research file ties to the binaries it read. For the part the lift left open, the verifier ran live eth_call tests on all seven endpoints: TSTORE in a reverted subcall is rolled back (outer TLOAD gives 5), TSTORE in a successful subcall is visible to the caller (gives 7), and SSTORE in a reverted subcall is rolled back (gives 5). These are the semantics the unlock and delta accounting in src/ rely on. The 8f0ccac image identity question stays open as the research lead says.
